Messages.Author: Mike Ooi
Messages.Body:
LSJ,

I have a question about some errata to Mask of 1000 Faces.

A minion attempting to block before the Mask was played is still attempting
to block after the Mask is played. If the Masking vampire is an Aching
Beauty, the controller of the minion attempting to block would have to pay a
pool for the attempt, for example. [LSJ 19990106]

If another non-Aching Beauty vampire Masks after the Aching Beauty vampire
and adds stealth, does the Methuselah controlling the attempted-blocking
minion still pay pool for the Aching Beauty? My guess is no, because there
is no successful block.

Does Cher more closely resemble the artwork on Aching Beauty or Mask of 1000
Faces?

-Mike Ooi
